_doc: The assistant's knowledge graph vocabulary. The wiki-to-graph model (concept, fact, procedure, schema) plus one kind, judgment, and one edge, supersedes. What a page is about (a person, an organization, a project, a lane) is its `topics:` value, not a kind; how two pages connect is the reason written on a `related` link. Add a kind or edge type only when a real question cannot be answered without it, and say which question (kb/tools/wiki-to-graph/reference/custom-vocabulary.md, 'Before you extend it').

descriptions.judgment: a standing rule the assistant follows, usually learned from a correction
descriptions.supersedes: a newer page, file or decision replaces an older one; the unsuperseded one is current
